scripts.bench:matchers: bun run build && bun run bench/bench-matchers.ts
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter '*' typecheck && bun run typecheck:release
scripts.test:coverage: bun --config=./bunfig.coverage.toml test packages/runtime/test packages/shim-bun/test packages/shim-hono/test packages/shim-node/test packages/shim-express/test example/e2e.test.ts --coverage --reporter=dots --timeout 30000 && bun scripts/check-coverage.ts
scripts.check:conformance: bun run --filter @typespex/runtime build && bun run --filter @typespex/emitter build && bun scripts/check-http-conformance.mjs
